items.title: 68436_Alberta Hunter oral history interview
items.q: I didn't know Mahalia very well at the time, see.

ctx.x: Yes, Apollo, and asked her if she would ask Mahalia to do it. I didn't know Mahalia very well at the time, see. So she said, well, I don't know, you know. She don't know she's working -- I was as smart as she was. I don't know, but you leave it here. So I did.

And anyhow, Mahalia recorded it. It was a good song. One day Doc Wheeler and I were talking. I was at Doc Wheeler's house to see his wife, Judy, and he says, girl, Mahalia just made a record that's out of this world. I say, yes? Said, yes.
